payload.purpose_context: The repository has agent workflow tooling but no application toolchain yet. This mission sets up the Bun workspace skeleton, strict typing, built-in lint and format, version pinning, and a pre-commit check so later product missions start from a consistent, verified base.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give the repository a working Bun-based monorepo foundation with local quality checks.

options: Pin exact 1.4.4-canary.1; move to stable 1.4.4 when released
payload.question: How should the Bun version be pinned while on canary?

options: Auto-format staged files and restage; block commit on lint errors
Check only: block on format or lint problems, never modify files
payload.question: What should the pre-commit hook do?

options: No, typecheck runs in the review gate only
payload.question: Should the pre-commit hook also run the type check (bun check)?

payload.final_answer: Auto-format staged files and restage; block commit on lint errors

payload.question: Should this mission run grace-init to start architecture tracking with the workspace skeleton?

payload.final_answer: Yes, include grace-init; grace lint joins pre-commit and review gate

options: No dependencies; avoid Bun APIs in TS for now
payload.question: Approve @types/bun as the only devDependency (pulls bun-types, @types/node, undici-types) so strict typecheck understands Bun APIs?
